result.rationale: The 2016 source is a multi-financier pool, not a legal Generate platform. Full retirement is also wrong: Stem identifies Generate-Stem LCR, LLC (SPV IV), formed 2017-06-30, and still carried its 50% interest at 2025 year-end; SPE obligations and repayments continued through 2026-06-30. Replace the unnamed umbrella with this LCR SPE.

identityResolution.boundary: Co-owned SPE that legally purchased Southern California behind-the-meter systems; not Stem, the $350 million pool or all Stem SPVs.
identityResolution.legacy: Generate discloses a separate $10 million Stem SPV, likely Stem Finance SPV II (formed 2015-01-23), but its outside investor is UNRESOLVED.

owners.vehicle: SPV IV Class A managing interest
SPV IV Class B non-managing interest

ownershipResolution.resolution: SPV IV holds legal title. Stem remains host counterparty/operator and bears warranties and operating duties; investor receipts amortize Stem's nonrecourse obligation. Exact Generate member/fund is undisclosed.

operatingResolution.program: SCE West LA Basin LCR behind-the-meter storage
operatingResolution.scale: Funding right up to 85 MW/340 MWh; SCE selected Stem for 85 MW under two contracts. These are ceilings, not verified deployment.
operatingResolution.contracts: Hosts sign 10-year fixed contracts. Hosts, CODs and expiries are undisclosed; broader-pool customers cannot be assigned to Generate.
operatingResolution.continuity: SCE still lists Stem's LCR network; Stem reports continuing SPE cash flows and obligations.

acquisitionExitCheck.details: No sale, transfer, refinance, foreclosure, dissolution or Generate exit found. Aggregate SPE obligations fell from $43.4 million at 2025 year-end to $37.2 million at 2026-06-30; H1 repayments were $4.7 million. SPV-level allocation is undisclosed. Logan's Canadian sale process is unrelated.

Generate-Stem LCR, LLC formed; Stem took 50% Class B.

result.recommendedListAction: Retain Generate–Stem LCR / Generate-Stem LCR, LLC with 2017 entry and ACTIVE_RUNOFF status; retire the generic 2016 umbrella, preserve SPV II only as unresolved history, and exclude SPV III and the broader pool from Generate attribution.
